note: Reviewed exceptions for qa/secret-scan.js. Each entry is keyed by the SHA-256 prefix of the matched VALUE, not by file or line, so a real credential pasted into the same file produces a different fingerprint and still fails the scan. Every reason must state why the value cannot open anything.

entries.reason: Synthetic QA/CI encryption key, crafted as a distinct 32-byte byte-pattern so the key-separation check has distinct inputs. It protects only the disposable QA database and temporary directories, and is committed on purpose so a probe can run without a developer secret.
A deliberately TOO-SHORT session pepper used as a negative fixture: the assertion is that the production schema REFUSES it. It is the value the test is designed to reject.
